_doc: Local models the studio knows. models/gen-config.py turns a hardware profile (models/profiles/*.json) plus this catalog into the llama-swap config, the download list and the OpenCode config. 'slot': big = the worker GPU, small = a second small GPU. 'args': llama-server flags after the common ones (context and sampling); 'n_cpu_moe': MoE expert layers kept in system RAM (VRAM-dependent: profiles may override). 'tested' summarises our measurements (docs/models.md has the details).

bonsai2-27b.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B (Qwen3.8-27B, PTQ1_0)
notes: min_p 0.05 is required: Bonsai produces gibberish with min_p 0.
reasoning_effort "low" is not supported by the model.
Needs the PrismML llama.cpp fork (PTQ1_0 ternary format).
bonsai2-27b.tested: capability suite 19/20 (~3x slower than Qwen3.6); Godot suite 4/4, best-looking clip; 188K long-context recall

bonsai2-27b-32k.name: Bonsai 2 27B, 32K context (co-residency with a renderer on the same GPU)
bonsai2-27b-32k.tested: GPU co-residency benchmark: UE 1080p render +17% time; too little context for agent work

qwen3.6-35b-a3b.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE UD-Q4_K_XL, experts partly in RAM
notes: --n-cpu-moe N keeps the expert weights of the first N layers in system RAM
qwen3.6-35b-a3b.tested: capability suite 19/20, median 2-7 min per task (default worker); Godot suite 1/4 (behaviour + time)

gemma4-26b-a4b.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B UD-Q4_K_XL + vision
notes: 17 GB of weights: experts of the first N layers live in system RAM (--n-cpu-moe). At 131K ctx
N=8 runs out of VRAM on 16 GB; N=12 loads at 15.4 of 16 GB; 13 keeps some headroom.
gemma4-26b-a4b.tested: Godot suite 4/4 in 32 min (fastest, fewest turns): Godot worker (provisional)

qwen3.8-27b-q3.name: Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q3_K_XL (dense; only 49K context fits in 16 GB)
notes: The GGUF's own chat template rejects Claude Code's 'developer' role (HTTP 500): use Bonsai's (same model family).
qwen3.8-27b-q3.tested: Godot suite 1/4, limited by the 49K context (Claude Code's system prompt + task overflow it)

mellum2.1-12b.name: Mellum2.1 12B-A2.5B Thinking Q6_K (fully in VRAM)
mellum2.1-12b.tested: Godot suite 0/4 (older llama.cpp); current llama.cpp: coding bug fix passed, Godot race logic failed; log triage 0.38-0.62, recall often reasons past a 4K answer budget; not a worker (evals/scorecard-decide.md)

clef-flash.name: Clef-Flash decision model Q4_K_M + vision (frame QA via /v1/systemone, no text generation)
notes: A decision model: answers typed questions (choice/score/noul) on POST /v1/systemone, no chat.
The whole prompt must fit one batch, hence -b/-ub = -c. Needs a llama.cpp with decision-model support (/v1/systemone).
clef-flash.tested: frame QA on 96 real frames: 95% (defects 96%, black 99%, exposure 89%) at 0.42 s/frame; Gemma 4 26B 92% at 7.3 s. Job logs: 79% of causes (Spark 87%)

gemma4-e4b.name: Gemma 4 E4B UD-Q4_K_XL + vision (small GPU)
notes: Per-layer embeddings (a lookup table, ~1/3 of the file) stay in system RAM (-ot), so the 5 GB file fits on 6 GB.
gemma4-e4b.tested: 2 runs: triage 0.69 (best small model; Spark 0.56, Bonsai 0.88) in ~90 s, vision 0.78/0.81 (misses overexposure), recall 3/3 at 28K

ministral3-8b.name: Ministral 3 8B Instruct 2512 IQ4_XS + vision (small GPU, tight)
ministral3-8b.tested: 2 runs: triage 0.38, vision 0.65/0.62, 16K context too small for the recall test: not recommended

spark-4b.name: Spark-X2.5-4B Q8_0 (small/fast slot)
spark-4b.tested: log triage 0.75 in ~20 s; never for multi-step tool work

qwen3.5-4b.name: Qwen3.5-4B UD-Q6_K_XL + vision (small GPU)
qwen3.5-4b.tested: capability-suite candidate for the small GPU (vision on CPU: only ~400 MB VRAM headroom on 6 GB)

qwen3.5-9b.name: Qwen3.5-9B IQ4_XS, text only (small GPU, tight)
qwen3.5-9b.tested: capability-suite candidate for the small GPU
